d:
The Slow Interview with Neelesh Misra this time brings to you award-winning actor "Nawazuddin Siddiqui". (Part 1)
The Slow Interview has features artists like Pankaj Tripathi, Manoj Bajpayee, Anurag Kashyap, Salman Khan’s father Salim Khan and Vishal Bhardwaj. Nawazuddin Siddiqui is well known for movies and TV shows like Sacred Games, Gangs of Wasseypur, Bajrangi Bhaijaan, Manjhi - The Mountain Man, Raees etc. Nawazuddin Siddiqui also known as "Nawaz" made his bollywood debut in 1999, with Aamir Khan in movie Sarfarosh.
